query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM crm_companies c
                WHERE $2 = 'company'
                  AND c.id = $3
                  AND c.team_id = $1
                  AND ($4 OR NOT c.hidden)
                UNION ALL
                SELECT 1
                FROM crm_contacts ct
                JOIN crm_companies c ON c.id = ct.company_id
                WHERE $2 = 'contact'
                  AND ct.id = $3
                  AND c.team_id = $1
                  AND ($4 OR NOT (ct.hidden OR c.hidden))
            ) AS "exists!"
